points.title: 童年与启蒙
points.description: 巴金原名李尧棠，出生于四川成都一个封建大家庭。他的童年深受封建礼教束缚，目睹了家族内部的矛盾与压迫，这些经历成为他后来创作的重要素材。在此期间，他接受了传统教育，同时也接触了新思想，特别是五四运动带来的新思潮，对他产生了深远影响。1923年，他离开成都前往上海，开始了新的人生旅程。
points.descriptionEn: Ba Jin, originally named Li Yaotang, was born into a feudal patriarchal family in Chengdu, Sichuan. His childhood was marked by the constraints of feudal ethics, and he witnessed the contradictions and oppression within his family, which later became important material for his writings. During this period, he received traditional education while also being exposed to new ideas, particularly the New Thought brought by the May Fourth Movement, which profoundly influenced him. In 1923, he left Chengdu for Shanghai, embarking on a new life journey.

points.title: 求学与思想形成
points.description: 巴金在上海求学期间，接触了无政府主义思想，深受克鲁泡特金等人著作的影响。1927年，他赴法国留学，在巴黎期间完成了处女作《灭亡》，这部作品表达了对封建社会的强烈批判和对自由平等的向往。这一时期，他确立了以文学为武器改造社会的信念，并开始使用'巴金'这一笔名，取自巴枯宁和克鲁泡特金的名字组合，表明了他的无政府主义立场。
points.descriptionEn: During his studies in Shanghai, Ba Jin was exposed to anarchist ideas, deeply influenced by the works of figures like Kropotkin. In 1927, he went to France for further studies. In Paris, he completed his debut work 'Destruction,' which expressed strong criticism of feudal society and yearning for freedom and equality. During this period, he established his belief in using literature as a weapon to transform society and began using the pen name 'Ba Jin,' derived from a combination of Bakunin and Kropotkin's names, indicating his anarchist stance.

points.title: 创作高峰期
points.description: 从法国回国后，巴金定居上海，开始了他的创作黄金时期。这一时期，他创作了《家》《春》《秋》等'激流三部曲'，以及《雾》《雨》《电'等'爱情三部曲'，这些作品深刻揭露了封建家庭的黑暗和压迫，表达了对自由、民主的追求。他的作品深受青年读者喜爱，成为五四新文化运动后文学界的重要力量。同时，他积极参与进步文化活动，与鲁迅等左翼作家保持密切联系，形成了自己的文学风格和思想体系。
points.descriptionEn: After returning from France, Ba Jin settled in Shanghai and entered his golden period of creation. During this time, he wrote the 'Torrent Trilogy' ('Family,' 'Spring,' and 'Autumn') and the 'Love Trilogy' ('Fog,' 'Rain,' and 'Electricity'), which profoundly exposed the darkness and oppression of feudal families and expressed the pursuit of freedom and democracy. His works were deeply loved by young readers, becoming an important force in the literary world after the May Fourth New Culture Movement. Meanwhile, he actively participated in progressive cultural activities and maintained close contact with left-wing writers like Lu Xun, forming his own literary style and ideological system.

points.title: 抗战时期的创作
points.titleEn: Creative Work During the War of Resistance
points.description: 抗日战争爆发后，巴金辗转于重庆、上海等地，继续坚持创作。这一时期，他的创作主题转向了民族救亡和抗战，创作了《火》三部曲等作品，表达了对侵略者的愤怒和对民族解放的渴望。同时，他积极参与抗日救亡运动，担任多种文化职务，团结进步文化人士，为抗战文化事业做出了重要贡献。尽管身处战乱，巴金仍坚持文学创作，他的作品成为鼓舞民众抗战精神的重要力量。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, Ba Jin moved between Chongqing, Shanghai, and other places, continuing to create. During this period, his creative themes shifted to national salvation and the anti-Japanese war, producing works like the 'Fire' trilogy, expressing anger against the invaders and longing for national liberation. Meanwhile, he actively participated in the anti-Japanese salvation movement, held various cultural positions, and united progressive cultural figures, making significant contributions to the cause of anti-Japanese culture. Despite the turmoil of war, Ba Jin persisted in literary creation, and his works became an important force in inspiring the people's anti-war spirit.

points.title: 新中国时期的文学活动
points.description: 新中国成立后，巴金定居北京，担任中国作家协会主席等职务，成为新中国文学界的重要领导人。在政治运动频繁的年代，他的创作受到一定限制，但仍坚持写作，创作了《随想录》等重要作品。特别是晚年，他以极大的勇气和真诚，在《随想录》中反思了自己在历次政治运动中的经历和思想变化，被誉为'二十世纪中国文学的良心'。巴金晚年致力于文学翻译和编辑工作，培养年轻作家，为中国现代文学的发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献。
points.descriptionEn: After the founding of New China, Ba Jin settled in Beijing and served as chairman of the Chinese Writers' Association, becoming an important leader in the literary world of the new country. During the frequent political movements, his creation was somewhat restricted, but he continued to write, producing important works like 'Random Thoughts.' Especially in his later years, with great courage and sincerity, he reflected on his experiences and ideological changes during various political movements in 'Random Thoughts,' hailed as 'the conscience of 20th-century Chinese literature.' In his later years, Ba Jin devoted himself to literary translation and editing, nurturing young writers, making indelible contributions to the development of modern Chinese literature.

appraisal.zh: 巴金是中国现代文学史上承前启后的重要作家，其作品深刻揭露封建社会的黑暗，表达对自由、民主与人性的追求，影响了几代读者；晚年《随想录》以真诚的自我反思成为中国知识分子良心的象征。也有研究者指出，他的作品情感过于直白，艺术技巧相对单一，新中国成立后的创作受政治环境影响而缺乏独立性，其早期无政府主义信念与后来立场的转变亦受质疑。但总体而言，他以「说真话」坚持文学的社会责任，其创作真实记录了时代变迁与知识分子的心路历程。
appraisal.en: Ba Jin is a pivotal figure in modern Chinese literature, whose works exposed the darkness of feudal society and voiced the pursuit of freedom, democracy, and humanity, influencing generations; his later Random Thoughts, with its candid self-reflection, became a symbol of intellectual conscience. Yet some researchers note that his writing is emotionally too direct and artistically simple, that his post-1949 work lacked independence under political pressure, and that his shift from early anarchism has been questioned. Still, his commitment to 'speaking truth' and literature's social responsibility, and his faithful record of his era, remain widely recognized.

supporter.zh: 巴金是中国现代文学巨匠，他的作品深刻揭露了封建社会的黑暗，表达了对自由、民主和人性的追求。作为'五四'新文化运动的代表人物之一，他的文学创作影响了几代中国人。晚年创作的《随想录》以其真诚的自我反思和勇气，成为中国知识分子良心的重要象征。巴金不仅是一位杰出的作家，也是一位坚定的社会改革者，他用笔作为武器，为中国的社会进步和文学发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献。
supporter.en: Ba Jin was a giant of modern Chinese literature whose works profoundly exposed the darkness of feudal society and expressed the pursuit of freedom, democracy, and humanity. As one of the representatives of the May Fourth New Culture Movement, his literary creation influenced several generations of Chinese people. His later work 'Random Thoughts,' with its sincere self-reflection and courage, became an important symbol of the conscience of Chinese intellectuals. Ba Jin was not only an outstanding writer but also a firm social reformer who used his pen as a weapon, making indelible contributions to China's social progress and literary development.

critic.zh: 批评者认为巴金的作品存在明显的政治倾向性，特别是在新中国成立后，他的创作受到政治环境的影响，部分作品缺乏艺术独立性。此外，他早期信奉的无政府主义思想与后来的政治立场存在矛盾，这种思想转变也受到一些质疑。在文学风格上，有评论认为他的作品情感过于直白，艺术技巧相对单一，缺乏深度和复杂性。尽管如此，巴金对中国现代文学的贡献仍然不可忽视，他的作品真实记录了那个时代的社会变迁和知识分子的心路历程。
critic.en: Critics argue that Ba Jin's works exhibit clear political tendencies, especially after the founding of New China, when his creation was influenced by the political environment, and some works lacked artistic independence. Furthermore, his early anarchist beliefs contradicted his later political stance, and this ideological shift has been questioned by some. In terms of literary style, some critics believe his works are emotionally too straightforward, with relatively simplistic artistic techniques, lacking depth and complexity. Nevertheless, Ba Jin's contributions to modern Chinese literature cannot be ignored, as his works truthfully recorded the social changes and intellectual journey of that era.

objective.zh: 从历史和文化视角看，巴金是中国现代文学史上承前启后的重要人物，他的创作跨越了从封建社会到新中国的重要历史时期。他的作品不仅是文学成就，更是那个时代社会变迁的见证。巴金以'说真话'为创作原则，坚持文学的社会责任，这种态度在中国现代文学中具有特殊意义。在流行文化中，巴金被视为知识分子的良心代表，他的《随想录》成为反思历史的重要文本。巴金的生平和创作，展现了中国知识分子在复杂历史环境中的挣扎、坚持与反思，成为中国现代文化的重要符号。
objective.en: From a historical and cultural perspective, Ba Jin was an important figure bridging the gap in modern Chinese literary history, whose creation spanned the crucial historical period from feudal society to New China. His works are not only literary achievements but also witnesses to the social changes of that era. Ba Jin adhered to the principle of 'speaking truth' in his creation and insisted on the social responsibility of literature, an attitude of special significance in modern Chinese literature. In popular culture, Ba Jin is regarded as a representative of the conscience of intellectuals, and his 'Random Thoughts' has become an important text for historical reflection. Ba Jin's life and work showcase the struggles, persistence, and reflection of Chinese intellectuals in complex historical environments, becoming an important symbol of modern Chinese culture.

self.zh: 我写作不是因为我有才华，而是因为我有感情。
self.en: I write not because I have talent, but because I have emotions.
